question: What modified observance is permitted when the practitioner is unable to follow the full rule?
premises: The practitioner may be unable to perform the full observance
Eating once at twilight is prescribed
inference: When unable, the practitioner may take one meal at twilight with post-meal contemplation
uncertainties: The compounds bhuktorddhabhāvanā and ekakām are interpreted from context and given forms
plain_english: When unable, there is contemplation after eating, with one meal taken at twilight.
